first_error_behavior: Save returns on the first of four checks. Validate is source-ordered and returns on the first active failure; its two date failures return literal true, while later failures return undefined. Success disables controls before conditionally showing the success alert based on global flag.

rules.condition: Transaction month is 00 with otherwise valid two-digit day and four-digit year.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: The lower-bound test is month < 0, so 00 is accepted.

rules.condition: Month is numeric but day or four-character year is nonnumeric.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.official_behavior: isNaN(result[0] || result[1] || result[2]) tests only the first truthy component; a four-letter year can pass all active checks.
rules.recommended_app_behavior: Parse and validate each component independently.

rules.exact_message: Please enter a valid TIN
rules.official_behavior: The helper clears the value; static segmented TIN controls are not shown invoking this full-value helper.

rules.condition: checkTIN receives fewer than 12 characters.
rules.rejected_behavior: The active operation stops unless official_behavior states otherwise.
rules.exact_message: TIN should not be less 12 digits.
rules.official_behavior: The grammar is defective and no checksum is checked.
